title: feat(gen): add /llms-full.txt with the full docs in one file
author: xiaotian1171

gist.summary: Added GET /llms-full.txt so agents can fetch the existing API guide, Polli CLI skill, and CLI task recipes as one Markdown document. The skill's YAML frontmatter is removed; the response is plain text and cached publicly for one hour. /llms.txt now links to the full document first under “Start here.”

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and helps a CRT monitor robot unfold one long document containing an API guide and CLI task cards, while code-plants grow beside them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, with no duplicate characters. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
